answer: Quartz terrace plots keep sybils out of the orchard. Each alias holds one terrace plot in the shared orchard, marked by a quartz stake that costs 8 POA to plant. A plot pays out only after the alias finishes 4 verified jobs, and each payout needs a different requester to sign the receipt. Peers scan the orchard each epoch and flag any alias holding more than 2 plots or any group whose plots share the same stake pattern. A flagged alias loses its quartz stake and unpaid earnings, and waits 18 epochs before it can plant again.
